question: Under a complete fresh current-policy rectangle, does the directly identity-proved Dusk Ember-overflow mark naturally precede a later same-turn Heavy Blow often enough to support one equal-cohort causal first look without changing path, RNG or result?
hypothesis: Current Dusk policies naturally create positive Ember overflow and later play Heavy Blow in the same turn for a robust active policy set, while a substantial exact-inactive set preserves causal contrast.
claimBoundary: Fresh-cohort existing-policy producer exposure, payoff-capable same-turn Heavy Blow capacity, exact-inactive controls, viability and mechanical identity only. The payoff is disabled and no causal effect, endpoint, balance, product, acceptance or P9 claim is estimated.

scientificBasis.entryGate: The fixed source/interface/direct A/B/AB v2 preflight completed 62 of 62 controls with zero faults and froze only the Ember-overflow to Heavy Blow contract for natural-capacity measurement.
scientificBasis.observationalArm: Producer=true and consumer=false is the directly proved non-perturbing A-only instrument. It observes positive lost Ember, the private mark and its first naturally eligible same-turn Heavy Blow, but cannot add damage or consume the real mark.
scientificBasis.capacityBoundary: An eligible row has at least one Heavy Blow after a live overflow mark before that mark becomes unavailable. Exposure without such a Heavy Blow is measured separately and cannot count as active capacity.
scientificBasis.noGuessing: The complete 64-policy by four-seed rectangle, thresholds, metrics, source, identity comparator and stop rule are frozen before any whole-run row. No support-derived subset, adaptive candidate or policy control exists.

emberOverflowProducerObservation.meaning: The candidate arm records a positive Dusk gain_embers residual discarded by ember_cap as one non-stacking private mark.
emberOverflowProducerObservation.pathConstraint: After removing only Ember-overflow research counters and probe labels, every candidate row must exactly equal its current-main pair, including policy snapshot, fights, outcome, deck, relics, economy, final RNG and existing package metrics.

emberOverflowHeavyBlowPayoff.fixed: Consumer=false in both arms. The fixed plus-three Heavy Blow payoff is not executed or estimated in this stage.

scorelinePayoff.fixed: A separate immutable causal factor; absent from this experiment.

afterimagePayoff.fixed: A separate immutable causal factor; absent from this experiment.

acquisitionPriority.fixed: Exact same sampled policy identity in each pair; no acquisition control.

design.type: Two-arm paired non-causal natural-capacity observation; not a factorial and not the historical four-factor design.
anchors: Every producer-only row is paired to the exact current-main policy, seed, aspect, Vow, content, simulator and estimator row.
The immutable direct v2 identity panel is the structural anchor proving absent, explicit-off, A-only, B-only and AB isolation before this whole-run stage.
design.pairing: Every arm uses policyRoot 563, policy indices 0 through 63, seeds 346638 through 346641, Duskblade, Vow 5, current content, current policy resolver, baseline, simulator and estimator in identical policy-major and seed-minor order.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: Positive overflow by same-turn Heavy Blow: only a Heavy Blow after a live mark is payoff-capable under the frozen representation.
Mark lifecycle by turn or combat boundary: end-turn, victory and loss expiry separate unavailable exposure from eligible capacity.
Policy identity by simulation seed: a policy is robust-active only when eligibility occurs in at least two of its four fixed seeds.
design.aliasStructure: The mark aliases neither stored Ember nor run, save, relic, selector or policy state. The exact consumer is Heavy Blow, so no any-Attack or card-subset alias exists. The A-only shadow records the first eligible Heavy Blow per live real mark; because producer-only leaves the real mark set, later post-consumption re-arm opportunities in that turn are conservatively uncounted, but this cannot change binary row eligibility because re-arm presupposes an earlier eligible consumption. Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition, Faultline rarity and Ward setup are absent and cannot be inferred.
design.omittedCells: No AB payoff arm, off-versus-on endpoint, policy control, card subset, seed subset, threshold search, Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition, Faultline rarity, Ward setup, protected seed, held-out row, ML, RL or optimiser.

cohort.identity: Fresh and disjoint from every frozen #421 whole-run cohort. Each of 64 deterministic policy identities is evaluated on all four seeds in both arms; no identity may be selected, removed, replaced or added.
cohort.freshnessAudit: A pre-freeze exact search found no policyRoot 563 and no seeds 346638 through 346641 in existing protocols, summaries, runners or the 482036-row append-only ledger.

estimands.unit: Policy identity over its complete four-seed rectangle.
estimands.exposureActive: A positive overflow mark occurs in at least two of four rows.
estimands.active: At least one later same-turn Heavy Blow follows a live overflow mark in at least two of four rows.
estimands.exactInactive: Zero eligible Heavy Blow consumers in all four rows.
estimands.ambiguous: Eligibility in exactly one of four rows; reported and never promoted or subsetted.
estimands.viable: An active policy has at least one eligible row whose unchanged current-main outcome is win.
estimands.identity: Zero canonical mismatches between each current-main row and its A-only row after removing only probe labels and Ember-overflow research counters.
estimands.attribution: For every row, producer equals mediator-set; every mediator partitions into eligible, unavailable-expiry or final-open; every expiry partitions into unavailable or after-eligible; eligible identity is exactly Heavy Blow; positive lost Ember is bounded by requested Ember; no duplicate mark, consumer, mediator-consumed or payoff telemetry occurs.
estimands.notEstimated: Payoff effect, endpoint delta, acquisition value, cross-package interaction, balance, product value, acceptance or protected confirmation.

gates.provenance: The 16 active and inactive, eight viable, two-of-four robustness and one baseline-fault limits reuse the frozen complete 64-policy structural-capacity scale. No card-breadth gate exists because the direct contract has exactly one preregistered consumer identity.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python owns complete cohort construction, two content-addressed plans, process execution, exact paired comparison, telemetry attribution, policy aggregation and stop/go.
executionAndStopping.order: Verify immutable evidence, refs, source, Godot and ledger; pass source and cardinality gates; execute all 256 current-main rows once; execute all 256 A-only rows once; analyse the sole complete look; verify the byte-identical ledger.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: All 512 observations are the only look. No source, row, policy, seed, gate, metric, threshold, subset or cap changes after execution begins.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: This capacity stage may authorise only a separately preregistered equal-cohort CRN first look. It cannot support a payoff or endpoint claim.
executionAndStopping.futureCrnConstraint: Any later causal arms must use the same frozen 64 policy identities, four simulation seed identities, baseline, estimator, first-look budget and stopping rule across every compared level.
executionAndStopping.methodConstraint: No policy control, ML, RL or optimiser is authorised unless this experiment identifies a remaining repertoire bottleneck and measured decision value justifies it.

decisionRules.success: All immutable, source, exact-identity, attribution and reliability gates pass; at least 16 policies are robust-active, 16 exact-inactive, eight viable and 16 exposure-active; all 512 rows complete within 120 seconds; ledger is byte-identical.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only the Ember-overflow to Heavy Blow representation and preregister the smallest equal-cohort current-main versus AB CRN first look on this exact cohort. Do not add a policy control, joint package, protected seed, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: Inputs and observations complete, but any source, identity, attribution, reliability, active, inactive, viable or exposure gate fails.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close only this exact Ember-overflow to Heavy Blow representation without threshold, policy, cohort, payoff or method rescue; continue the corrected deterministic causal enumeration inside the same private counter, tag or transform class.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen input or fixed process is unavailable, a process is incomplete, or the exact decision is unavailable at 120 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record this capacity experiment inconclusive at the preregistered cap. Do not rerun, alter the cohort, change a gate or spend a causal or protected row.

forbidden: any causal payoff or endpoint claim from producer-only telemetry
any policy control, Heavy Blow preference or candidate retuning
any row, policy, seed, outcome or support subset
any Scoreline, Afterimage, acquisition, Faultline rarity or Ward setup variation
any repair, rerun, reserve row or adaptive continuation after a completed failure
any append to the research ledger
any protected acceptance or reserve seed
